title: Tech Note: Creating a Custom ORDA Query Editor
author: Erick Lui, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: Hierarchical list / dropdown popup form objects
GET TABLE TITLES / GET FIELD TITLES
Entity selection to current selection conversion

historical_commentary.text: Building a custom query UI on top of dataClass.query() is still exactly how developers construct dynamic ORDA-based query builders today, so this note's approach is fully current; the classic 4D Query Editor mentioned as the 'old way' is itself increasingly a legacy UI as ORDA-first development has become the default across the platform.
related_updates: ORDA's dataClass.query() remains the standard query mechanism; the technique of dynamically building query row UI and combining it into a single query string is still valid practice
The 'classic 4D Query Editor' this note contrasts against is itself now largely a legacy UI feature as ORDA became the default data-access layer
